name: Pasifik Eurasia Lojistik Dis Ticaret A.S.
summary: Pasifik Eurasia Lojistik Dis Ticaret A.S. provides international rail, air, land and sea freight transportation, and international water transportation services in Europe, Asia, and Russia. It operates as a logistics company. The company operates in the fields of cargo loading and unloading services, railway freight transportation agency, intercity cargo by road, foreign trade, and customs. It also provides solutions to international transportation, intermodal transportation, multimodal transport, logistics, and terminal services. Pasifik Eurasia Lojistik Dis Ticaret A.S. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Ankara, Turkey.
